schema.description:
`POST .../account-access-consents` request body (the OB
`OBReadConsentResponse1`-shaped staging body): the intent the TPP
stages.

ExpirationDateTime.description:
The ExpirationDateTime of the consent (ISO 8601; absent = the
default window).

TransactionFromDateTime.description: The TransactionFromDateTime (AIS: the lookback window start).

risk.description: The risk payload (genuinely freeform - the OB risk document).
